0022600217.text: The Washington Wizards (4-7, 2-5 on the road, 3-7 in their last 10, on a four-game losing streak) visit the Indiana Pacers (3-8, 0-5 at home, 2-8 in their last 10, on a two-game losing streak) for the Wizards' 12th game of the 2026-27 season, with both teams having played 11 games. The teams have not met yet this season, and Washington won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 131-118 victory in Washington on February 20, 2026. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Bilal Coulibaly is day-to-day with a hand injury and is a game-time decision, while Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain).
